passes.name: Liftoff Pass
passes.description: The first release, open to all developers and community members.
passes.eligibility: Open to all developers and community members. Maximum 2 tickets per order. Each ticket must have a different attendee’s details.
benefits: Full-day admission across all technical tracks
passes.summary: A full day of talks, a DevFest swag kit, lunch and refreshments.

passes.name: Cadet Pass
passes.description: For currently enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students.
passes.eligibility: For currently enrolled college and university students only. Enter your college name, degree and graduation year at checkout. Bring your original, active physical student photo ID, matching your registration name. Maximum 1 ticket per order.
benefits: Full-day admission across all technical tracks
passes.note: Working professionals booking this pass may have their registration cancelled or be required to pay the difference for a Commander upgrade at the venue. Missing valid student ID may mean denied entry without refund or an on-site upgrade fee.
passes.summary: Full-day access, a student delegate kit, lunch and refreshments. Active student photo ID required.

passes.name: Commander Pass
passes.description: For engineers, architects, tech leads, managers and founders.
passes.eligibility: For working software engineers, architects, tech leads, engineering managers and founders. Register each team member with their own name, email address and LinkedIn profile.
benefits: Full-day conference admission and breakout room access
Corporate tax invoice available at checkout
passes.note: Volume discounts apply when booking multiple passes for engineering teams and startups. The checkout will show the applicable discount.
passes.summary: Conference and breakout access, partner networking, a delegate kit and meals. Team bookings welcome.

passes.name: Flight Deck Pass
passes.description: Curated access for founders, senior technical leaders and ecosystem partners.
passes.eligibility: Curated for founders, senior technical leadership and ecosystem partners. A private VIP access code is required to unlock booking in the ticket section on KonfHub.
benefits: Reserved front-row seating across keynotes and tracks
All-day Speaker & Partner Networking Lounge access
passes.note: Have a private VIP access code? Enter it in the KonfHub ticket section when this release opens. The code does not replace a completed registration.
passes.summary: Reserved seating, the speaker and partner lounge, an evening mixer and a premium kit. Private access code required.

passes.name: Last Orbit Pass
passes.description: A final chance to join, subject to venue capacity.
passes.eligibility: General registration for late-decision attendees. Allocation is subject to final venue hall capacity.
passes.note: Final-phase surge pricing applies. Delegate kits and swag are first come, first served, while supplies last.
passes.summary: Full-day technical tracks and conference lunch. Swag while supplies last.

passes.name: Observer Pass
passes.description: For community walk-ins attending main auditorium keynotes and open tracks.
passes.eligibility: For community walk-ins and session-only attendees.
passes.note: No conference lunch, tea or refreshments, workshop hall access, or delegate swag kit.
passes.summary: Main auditorium keynotes and open tracks. Food, workshops and swag are not included.

policies.title: All purchases are final
policies.text: Tickets cannot be cancelled, transferred, resold, rescheduled or refunded, including for personal scheduling conflicts or corporate travel changes.

policies.title: Entry and identification
policies.text: Bring your digital QR ticket and an original physical government-issued photo ID matching the attendee name on your registration. Present them at check-in for verification and badge collection.

policies.title: Accurate attendee details
policies.text: Provide each attendee’s own full name, email address, mobile number and LinkedIn profile URL. Your student or professional status and other eligibility information must be true and accurate. Organizers may verify details and supporting identification. False, misleading or unverifiable information may result in cancellation or refusal of entry.

policies.title: Cadet student ID check
policies.text: Cadet is for currently enrolled college and university students. Bring your original, active physical institutional photo ID matching your registration name, in addition to the general entry requirements. Without valid proof, organizers may deny entry without refund or require an on-site upgrade fee. Working professionals booking Cadet may have their registration cancelled or need to pay the difference for a Commander upgrade.

policies.title: Workshop access and capacity
policies.text: Check whether your selected pass includes workshop hall access. Where included, workshop seats are subject to capacity and any announced session-specific access or registration requirements. A conference ticket alone does not reserve a workshop seat.

policies.title: Kits, catering and pass inclusions
policies.text: Admission, food, refreshments, workshops and delegate kits are provided according to the inclusions of your selected pass. Any stated first-come, first-served or while-supplies-last conditions apply to the specified pass only.

policies.title: Flight Deck private access
policies.text: Flight Deck is a curated pass requiring a private VIP access code in the KonfHub ticket section. A code or expression of interest does not replace a completed registration. Only the benefits listed for this pass are included.

policies.title: Registration corrections
policies.text: If your own registration details contain an error, contact the organizers before the event. A correction request does not permit transferring a ticket to another person or changing the attendee’s identity.

policies.title: A welcoming community
policies.text: DevFest Indore is an inclusive, harassment-free conference. All attendees, speakers, partners and volunteers must follow the community code of conduct and organizer instructions. Organizers may revoke passes or require people to leave for harassment, disruptive behaviour or other conduct violations, without a refund.

bookingSteps.title: Find your pass
bookingSteps.text: Check the release window, eligibility and inclusions before choosing your pass.

bookingSteps.title: Book on KonfHub
bookingSteps.text: Continue to KonfHub to check available tickets, enter attendee details, review the total and complete payment.

bookingSteps.title: Keep your confirmation
bookingSteps.text: Follow the registration confirmation and entry instructions sent by KonfHub.

registrationChecklist.title: Add your LinkedIn URL before booking
registrationChecklist.text: For smoother registration, sign in to KonfHub and add your LinkedIn profile URL, full name and mobile number to your profile before booking. Use your own profile URL when entering attendee details.

registrationChecklist.title: One pass per person
registrationChecklist.text: Use a unique name, email address and LinkedIn profile for each attendee so their digital credential and QR code are issued correctly.

registrationChecklist.title: Tell us your food preference
registrationChecklist.text: Choose Veg or Jain Veg on the registration form to help us plan catering at Essentia.

registrationDeclaration: I confirm that the attendee details are accurate, that I meet the eligibility requirements for my selected pass, and that I have read and agree to the registration guidelines and community code of conduct. I understand that ticket purchases are final and tickets cannot be cancelled, transferred, resold, rescheduled or refunded.

registration.handoffText: KonfHub confirms availability and pricing and completes your registration.
registration.unavailableText: The registration link will be available here.
registration.finalSaleText: All purchases are final. No refunds or transfers.
registration.profileReminder: For smoother registration, add your own LinkedIn URL to your KonfHub profile before booking.
